description: Score email security (SPF, DMARC, DKIM, MX) for up to 100 domains in one call. $0.5 USDC on Base per call. Returns per-domain score, grade and issues plus a summary: grade counts, missing DMARC/SPF and worst 10. Bad input 400 and widespread DNS failure 502, not charged. Don't use this for one domain; /v1/score costs less. [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
